findings.title: build_zip_archive() crashed for any --output-dir outside --repo-root
findings.body: zip_path.relative_to(repo_root) raised an uncaught ValueError whenever the output directory wasn't a subpath of the repo root -- exactly the 'rebuild into a scratch dir to verify' pattern an auditor or CI job would naturally use. Fixed with a try/except falling back to a bare basename in the sidecar. Independently re-verified by a separate verification subagent: rebuild into /tmp exits 0 and shasum -c passes.

findings.title: Shipped ZIP did not contain PACKAGE_VALIDATION.json despite the package's own README advertising it as a deliverable
findings.body: build_zip_archive() ran before validate_chatgpt_project_sources.py ever executed as a separate script, so the file it produces was never present when the ZIP was built. Fixed by refactoring the validator into a callable run_validation() and having the assembler call it (writing PACKAGE_VALIDATION.json, failing closed on any gate failure) before zipping. Independently re-verified: unzip -l on a fresh build shows the file present with all_gates_pass:true.

findings.title: capture_complete trusted a self-reported flag instead of always recomputing it
findings.body: A future capture run with a paginator bug could have set capture_complete=true incorrectly and silently bypassed the fail-closed incomplete-capture guard. No live PR was affected (only #1123 is incomplete and correctly disclosed it). Fixed by always recomputing len(files)==changedFiles. Independently re-verified: a forged self-reported capture_complete=true with a real file-count mismatch was ignored, raising the FATAL error.

findings.title: No enum/allow-list validation on PR classification values
findings.body: A typo'd classification value in pr_classifications.json would have silently been treated as non-material rather than failing closed. No live occurrence (all 29 current values are valid). Fixed with a VALID_PR_CLASSIFICATIONS enum check. Independently re-verified: a scratch classifications file with a bogus value produced a clean FATAL exit naming the exact PR and value.
